extra.description: Measured Hadamard rotation effect on activation fixtures: kurtosis (Pearson) and INT4 SQNR
extra.fixture_regeneration: outliers fixture is gitignored and rebuilt deterministically by bench/hadamard_rescue.py from micro_kv_2k.pt + the committed injection.json
extra.measurement: deterministic sample of 512 rows; INT4 sym group=32; kurtosis window is scope-dependent (see kurtosis_window column): rotary_subspace = first rotary_dim channels for block_diag, full_head = all head_dim channels for full; Pearson convention (3.0 = Gaussian); sensitivity rows are in-memory deterministic variants of the pristine fixture, primary injection is 2 channels U(8.0,32.0)
